name: expanded-classes
author: BlaXun
description: Renewal's expanded advancements in pre-renewal, each the next step of its finished base class, which keeps every skill it has and levels to 175: a Ninja becomes a Kagerou or Oboro, a Gunslinger a Rebellion, a Star Gladiator a Star Emperor, a Soul Linker a Soul Reaper, a Super Novice an Expanded Super Novice. Each has its own gear, measured damage and skill descriptions. Needs level175-core; the third classes are the transcendent-third-classes mod.
